newsitem.title: USA: United Stationers gross margin rises.
newsitem.headline: United Stationers gross margin rises.

text.p: United Stationers Inc said Tuesday its gross margin increased for its second quarter, reflecting inventory investment and lower delivery costs.
The gross margin rose to 17.2 percent, compared with 16.3 percent for the quarter in 1996.

Operating expenses were 12.1 percent of net sales, compared with 11.9 percent in the previous period. The increase reflects the use of outside consultants, for example for preparations for the year 2000, and to accelerate its strategic planning process.
United Stationers reported second quarter earnings of $0.63 a share versus $0.32.
